edits.content:
version: 2
sources:
- name: raw
  schema: raw
  description: 'Public signals landed by `gta6 ingest` as Parquet under data/raw/ and loaded by `gta6
    load`. Every table is rebuilt from the files on each load; the newest pull wins per key. No post text,
    handles or usernames are stored.

    '
  tables:
  - name: wiki_pageviews
    description: Daily English Wikipedia pageviews by users (all access) per article.
  - name: trends_interest
    description: 'Google Trends relative interest (0-100) per term and day. Values only compare within
      one request_id; Google rescales every request to its own peak.

      '
  - name: bluesky_daily_hits
    description: 'Bluesky public search hitsTotal for one quoted seed phrase (optionally plus "gta") bounded
      to one UTC day. hits_total is NULL when the call failed.

      '
  - name: hn_daily_hits
    description: 'Hacker News (Algolia) nbHits for one quoted seed phrase (optionally plus "gta") over
      stories and comments in one UTC day. NULL when the call failed.

      '
  - name: economy_indicators
    description: 'Official economic data, one value per provider, indicator, geography and year: World
      Bank WDI world aggregates (WLD) and the IMF World Economic Outlook world series (WEOWORLD). A year
      a provider has not published is absent, never zero.'

-- One row per provider, indicator, geography and year of official economic data.
with source as (
    select * from {{ source('raw', 'economy_indicators') }}
)

select
    provider,
    indicator,
    geo,
    cast(year as integer) as year,
    cast(value as double) as value,
    cast(last_updated as date) as last_updated
from source

version: 2
models:
- name: stg_economy__indicators
  description: 'One row per provider, indicator, geography and year: official economic data.'
  columns:
  - name: provider
    description: world_bank (WDI) or imf_weo (World Economic Outlook).
  - name: indicator
    description: The provider's indicator code, e.g. SL.GDP.PCAP.EM.KD or NGDP_RPCH.
  - name: geo
    description: 'WLD: the world aggregate.'
  - name: year
    description: Calendar year the value describes.
  - name: value
    description: The published value, in the indicator's own unit.
  - name: last_updated
    description: When the World Bank last updated the indicator; NULL for the IMF.

-- Metric 2, GTA V to GTA 6: world productivity in every year from GTA V's launch year to
-- GTA 6's, and its real change since GTA V. One row per measure per year.
--   output_per_worker: World Bank GDP per person employed (constant 2021 PPP $).
--   output_per_person: World Bank GDP per capita (constant 2015 US$).
-- A year the World Bank has not published is estimated for output_per_person only: its last
-- published value grown by the IMF's world real GDP growth for each later year, less the
-- World Bank's latest world population growth. output_per_worker stays NULL there
-- (unavailable): no published world employment growth to carry it.
{%- set gta_v = var('gta_v_year', 2013) %}
{%- set gta_6 = var('gta_6_year', 2026) %}
with indicators as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_economy__indicators') }}
    where geo = 'WLD'
),

measures as (
    select * from (
        values
            ('output_per_worker', 'SL.GDP.PCAP.EM.KD', 'constant 2021 PPP $ per person employed', false),
            ('output_per_person', 'NY.GDP.PCAP.KD', 'constant 2015 US$ per person', true)
    ) as m (measure, source_indicator, unit, carried_by_imf)
),

years as (
    select cast(unnest(range({{ gta_v }}, {{ gta_6 }} + 1)) as integer) as year
),

actuals as (
    select indicator, year, value
    from indicators
    where provider = 'world_bank'
),

last_actual as (
    select indicator, max(year) as last_year, arg_max(value, year) as last_value
    from actuals
    group by indicator
),

gdp_growth as (
    select year, value as gdp_growth_pct
    from indicators
    where provider = 'imf_weo' and indicator = 'NGDP_RPCH'
),

pop_growth as (
    select arg_max(value, year) as pop_growth_pct
    from indicators
    where provider = 'world_bank' and indicator = 'SP.POP.GROW'
),

spine as (
    select
        measures.measure,
        measures.source_indicator,
        measures.unit,
        measures.carried_by_imf,
        years.year,
        actuals.value as actual_value,
        last_actual.last_year,
        last_actual.last_value,
        gdp_growth.gdp_growth_pct,
        pop_growth.pop_growth_pct
    from measures
    cross join years
    cross join pop_growth
    left join actuals
        on actuals.indicator = measures.source_indicator and actuals.year = years.year
    left join last_actual
        on last_actual.indicator = measures.source_indicator
    left join gdp_growth
        on gdp_growth.year = years.year
),

carried as (
    select
        *,
        -- Per-capita growth factor for a year past the last published one; NULL if the IMF
        -- has no growth for it, and a NULL anywhere in the chain keeps the rest NULL.
        case
            when carried_by_imf and year > last_year
                then (1 + gdp_growth_pct / 100) / (1 + pop_growth_pct / 100)
        end as growth_factor
    from spine
),

valued as (
    select
        *,
        case
            when actual_value is not null then actual_value
            when growth_factor is not null and bool_and(growth_factor is not null) over chain
                then last_value * exp(sum(ln(growth_factor)) over chain)
        end as value
    from carried
    window chain as (
        partition by measure, year > last_year
        order by year
        rows between unbounded preceding and current row
    )
),

based as (
    select
        valued.*,
        max(case when year = {{ gta_v }} then value end) over (partition by measure) as gta_v_value,
        max(case when value is not null then year end) over (partition by measure) as latest_year
    from valued
)

select
    md5(measure || '|' || cast(year as varchar)) as world_productivity_key,
    measure,
    year as data_year,
    make_date(year, 1, 1) as year_start,
    case year when {{ gta_v }} then 'GTA V' when {{ gta_6 }} then 'GTA 6' end as launch,
    value,
    unit,
    source_indicator,
    actual_value is null and value is not null as is_estimate,
    year = latest_year as is_latest,
    round(100 * (value / gta_v_value - 1), 1) as pct_change_since_gta_v
from based

-- Metric 2 is measured from GTA V's launch year: every measure needs its bookend value, or
-- every change since GTA V would read NULL.
select measure
from {{ ref('fct_world_productivity') }}
group by measure
having max(case when data_year = {{ var('gta_v_year', 2013) }} then value end) is null

declarations.description: One row per provider, indicator, geography and year: official economic data.

population.rule: Every published value as landed; unpublished years are absent.

assumptions.detail: its only value is WLD, the world aggregate code; no person or place of a person

declarations.description: Metric 2, GTA V to GTA 6: world productivity per year from 2013 to 2026 and its real change since GTA V's launch year. One row per measure per year.

population.rule: Every year from var gta_v_year (2013) to var gta_6_year (2026) for both measures, published or not; an unpublished, unestimated year keeps its row with a NULL value.

year_start.description: 1 January of data_year: the time axis.

launch.description: GTA V on 2013, GTA 6 on 2026, NULL in between.

value.null_rule: NULL when unpublished and not estimated: unavailable, never zero.
value.description: Real output in the measure's unit.

is_estimate.description: True when the value is carried by IMF growth, not published by the World Bank.

is_latest.description: True on the measure's latest year with a value.

pct_change_since_gta_v.null_rule: NULL when the year's value is unavailable.
pct_change_since_gta_v.description: Real change since GTA V's launch year, in percent.

assumptions.chosen: World Bank GDP per person employed and GDP per capita, world aggregate, real
assumptions.detail: user: productivity measured by actual economic indexes (GDP per capita) for the whole world, economic data only
user: bookended by the GTA V and GTA 6 releases (17 Sep 2013, 19 Nov 2026)

assumptions.decision: Years the World Bank has not published
assumptions.chosen: per capita carried by IMF WEO world real GDP growth less latest World Bank population growth, flagged is_estimate; per worker left NULL
assumptions.detail: the IMF WEO is the standard published source for the current year; no free published world employment growth to carry output per worker
